description: This file defines the LabelRepository interface for data access operations related to Label entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository. It provides methods for CRUD operations and specific queries like finding labels by owner, checking existence by name, etc.

classes.name: LabelRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Label entities, extending JpaRepository for CRUD operations with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByOwnerOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds a page of labels owned by a specific user, ordered by name in ascending order.

methods.name: findByIdAndOwner
methods.description: Retrieves a label by its ID and owner, returning an Optional.

methods.name: existsByOwnerAndNameIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks whether a label with a given name (case-insensitive) exists for a specific owner.
